name: complement C3b/C4b receptor 1 (Knops blood group)

function.text: CR1 is the approved symbol for complement C3b/C4b receptor 1 (Knops blood group). Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in complement component C3b binding; complement component C3b receptor activity; ATP export.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Bladder urothelial carcinoma; Colorectal carcinoma; Cancer Hotspots source tumor code: cscc. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Historical hotspot cohort observation; individual-allele significance and tumor-specific oncogenicity require review.
